A matching of exactly j core edges is realizable with positive priority probability for 0≤j≤floor(n/2), giving full support. Differentiating at z=1 and setting A=(1−u)^2 ∂_zF(u,1) gives (q+1)u A′=(1−2u)A+qu+u², whose explicit integral solution is entire; Taylor division yields the exact boundary constant and O_{q,R}(R^(−n)) for each fixed R>1.
